settings.title: The details you'd point out
settings.text: Light signature, grille texture, intakes and body lines. The parts you notice in a parking lot are the parts we keep.

settings.title: Two colours in one print
settings.text: White body over black details, printed together. Pick a matte or metallic body color and the lights stay bright white.

settings.title: Ready for your keys
settings.text: A keyring tab on the left, plus a split ring and a short chain in the box.

settings.title: No badges, on purpose
settings.text: Every design is logo-free. You know what it is. Everyone else will too.

settings.title: Started with one M3
settings.text: The line began as a keychain of our own G80, traced from a photo. Every car since follows the same rules.

settings.question: How big is it?
settings.answer: 80.5 mm wide and 3 mm thick, just under the width of a credit card. The height depends on the car.

settings.question: What comes with it?
settings.answer: The keychain, a split ring and a short chain.

settings.question: Why is there no badge on the front?
settings.answer: Logos and emblems belong to the car makers, so every Grille Talk design is logo-free. The shape, the lights and the grille do the talking.

settings.question: Which body colors can I pick?
settings.answer: White, matte red, matte yellow, matte gray, matte blue and metallic silver. The lights stay white and the details stay black whichever you pick.

settings.question: My car isn't here. Can you make it?
settings.answer: Send it through the request form. 40+ more cars are already in the works.
